subject: Operations on dynamic-capacity tables
notes: kb/Work PB1144 (landed). Three sentences (cite.py --check 14.6.9.2 each OK): (a) "all the remaining elements of the receiving table are space filled" - CobolVarGroup.ToFixedImage space-pads the component (pb393_move_varlen_table; pb1144_dyn_move_elements B4/B5). (b) "further elements are created and filled with spaces until the current capacity of the table is equal to its minimum capacity" - CobolDynTable.FromCurrentImage recreates the table from the sender's occurrences raised to the FROM minimum with space-filled elements (pb1144_dyn_move_recreate A/B). (c) "Correspondingly numbered elements are moved according to the rules of the MOVE statement" - MoveBinder.BindMoveOf binds BoundMove.ElementMoves: per corresponding table pair (VariableLengthCompatibility.CorrespondingTables) whose elementary elements are not identically described, the elementary MOVE over the two element places, looped by MoveEmitter.EmitElementMoves to the smaller of the two 14.6.9.1 current counts after the group transfer; group element pairs and identical descriptions keep the image transfer, which is then the MOVE's result. Witness pb1144_dyn_move_elements: 9(4) 1234/5678 into 99V99 dynamic and fixed -> 3400 7800; S9(4) -12 into 9(4) -> 0012; 9(6) into ZZ,ZZ9 edited; 9(4) into X(4); fixed 99V99 into dynamic 9(4) -> 0012 0056; WRITE FROM / READ INTO arms. An element pair 14.9.25.3 refuses is COBOL0819 at the MOVE (negative pb1144-dyn-element-move-illegal).
